kurz: A hard avocado in a paper bag with an apple softens a day or two sooner than one on its own.
bild_im_kopf: Like a contagious yawn: one ripe fruit gets the others going.
beobachtung: The avocado in the bag gives noticeably sooner, after one to three days.
erklaerung: The apple gives off the ripening gas [[ethylen|ethylene]]. It collects in the bag and starts the avocado ripening sooner.
schritte: Put one avocado in the paper bag with the apple and close it.
Leave the other avocado uncovered next to it.
Gently squeeze both each day and compare.
